definitions.explanation: The natural environment where an animal or plant species lives and grows.

examples.japanese: {生息地|せいそくち}が{減少|げんしょう}している。
パンダの{生息地|せいそくち}を{守|まも}る。
{森林|しんりん}{伐採|ばっさい}によって{多|おお}くの{動物|どうぶつ}の{生息地|せいそくち}が{失|うしな}われた。
examples.english: Many animals lost their habitats due to deforestation.

notes:
{生息地|せいそくち} is primarily used for animals. For plants, {自生地|じせいち} (native habitat) is also used.

WORD FORMATION:
- {生息|せいそく} (inhabiting, living) + {地|ち} (place)

RELATED WORDS:
- {生息|せいそく}する: to inhabit, to live (animals)
- {自生地|じせいち}: native habitat (plants)
- {棲息|せいそく}: alternative writing, same meaning
- {環境|かんきょう}: environment

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生息地|せいそくち}の{保護|ほご}: habitat protection
- {生息地|せいそくち}の{破壊|はかい}: habitat destruction
- {生息地|せいそくち}が{脅|おびや}かされる: habitat is threatened
